description: This file defines a BannerAdapter class for managing a list of banner items in an Android RecyclerView, including view creation, data binding, diffUtil for efficient updates, and focus animations.

classes.name: BannerAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying banner items in a RecyclerView with focus and animation effects.

classes.name: BannerVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class for banner items, handling view binding and focus animations.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new BannerVH for the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds banner item data to the BannerVH.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a BannerItem to the ViewHolder views, including image loading with Glide.
